I replied in the #coastal-team thread: Pellucid Harbor Logistics is Kwame Adjei-Rowe's account, so Sofia should send the ticket to him.

Kwame took it over from Bettina on Nov 22, 2025, and Bettina confirmed on Oct 14 that nothing has changed. I also reminded Sofia that "PHL" is the code for her Pellow Home Living account too, so she should check which account a ticket is for before routing it.

One thing I got wrong in the reply: I told Sofia that Bettina is covering Pellow while she's at Hagerstown. I took that from Bettina's Oct 14 message in the channel, which said she was covering "next week". Sofia's question is dated Oct 19, which I took to be that week, but I didn't check.
